report_emission_omission.detail: apps/editor/src/lib.rs places emit_smoke_report after gpui_kit::application().run(...). In gpui-pre-macos-0.3.11/src/platform.rs:591, cx.quit() invokes [NSApplication terminate:nil], which calls libc::exit(0) and does not unwind or return to the run() callsite. Post-run code in lib.rs cannot execute on macOS.

step_failure_hypothesis.detail: Because smoke_artifacts was created at step 1 but saved_roundtrip.rs at step 4 was never created, execution stopped between step 1 and step 4. In step 2 (smoke.rs:212-255), replace_text_in_range is called while workspace is borrowed mutably. Subscribed events are deferred in GPUI, and sleep_ms(30) awaits on background_executor().timer without pumping foreground AppKit dispatch. If line 242 returned Err due to visible_revision remaining 0, report.in_app_checks_passed was set to false and force_without_recovery initiated uncommitted quit. The exact in-memory error string is unobserved because the report was not written before process exit.
